title: Conditional massless background and BAO

baseline.label: Planck base ΛCDM comparison
baseline.scope: Changed neutrino/thermal sector and exact synthetic control point; Planck is contextual reference.
baseline.parameters_reason: Exact sourced values and chosen inputs are separately pinned in the candidate numerical reference.

modifications: Replace massive-neutrino/thermal sector with explicitly chosen massless fractional controls; supplied synthetic drag endpoint.
cosmology.background: E(a)^2=Omega_r/a^4+Omega_m/a^3+Omega_Lambda; chosen fractional inputs, Lambda from flatness.
cosmology.perturbations: Not included in this limited comparison.
observables: All 13 ordered D_M/r_d, D_H/r_d or D_V/r_d release coordinates
BAO Gaussian quadratic, log determinant, normalization and log density
Twin H0 control with fractions, supplied drag and release covariance fixed

scope: Reproducible experiments/lcdm-baseline: compare only the listed exported background and conditional-BAO quantities. Native H, D_H, D_V and the supplied-endpoint ruler support these computations internally; standalone values are not required exported comparison outputs. No SN profile, fit or full source inference.

combination_compatibility.basis: One declared background; observable lineage ideas inform the investigation, not extra physical components or independent probes.

source_evidence.locator: HTML S2.SS1 (Sec2.1): six sampled parameters, adiabatic power law, 0.05 Mpc^-1 pivot, one 0.06 eV plus two massless neutrinos, BBN PArthENoPE1.1/neutron880.2s; HTML S3.T1 caption: Plik marginalized means versus best fit, massive neutrino included in Omega_m, theta_MC versus theta_star; HTML S3.SS1 footnote14: T_CMB2.7255K; PDF p16 Table2: all eleven registered values/errors and TT,TE,EE+lowE+lensing column; no BAO; tanh reionization and BBN helium caption; HTML S7.SS5.SSS2: standard Neff3.046 text; Eq62 read but not used

HTML S1.E1, S1.E4, S1.E5, S1.EGx2: drag ruler, flat comoving transverse distance, radial distance and full neutrino background; HTML S3.SS1 and Eqs11–12: fiducial BAO templates, nuisance marginalization, DV definition and fit conditioning; HTML S3.T4 caption and seven used tracer rows: marginal means/stddev, systematic budget, superseded LRG3/ELG1 excluded; HTML S3.SS3: seven baseline distance measurements; BAO-only Omega_m and H0*r_d dependence; DR1 shares data with DR2; HTML S4.SS3: SN offsets/calibration degeneracy and sample overlap; HTML S5 and S6.E17: BAO-only sampled parameters and conditioned fitted result, not used as executable controls; HTML A2: baseline inter-bin systematic independence assumption and correlated-systematics sensitivity test
